# AI game sprite sheets with GPT Image 2.6 — Phaser and Godot atlases

**A character becomes a 4×4 GPT Image 2.6 sprite sheet, then frames, a looping GIF and a JSON atlas for Phaser or Godot.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1dadec5fbb07.webp" alt="A 4x4 sprite sheet of a cartoon knight sits on the left while the sliced frames play as a looping run cycle on the right." width="480"></p>

Make 2D game sprite sheets with GPT Image 2.6 on varg and turn them into game-ready files: a strict 4×4 sheet spec (16 frames, equal cells, fixed scale and ground line; credited to @SSSS_CRYPTOMAN, translated from Japanese), then scripts/slice.sh cuts the sheet into frames, keys out the background, puts every frame on one ground line, and writes a looping GIF, a clean atlas PNG and a JSON atlas (TexturePacker JSON Hash) for Phaser, with the Godot steps. Also covers the native GIF route and turning its frames into an atlas. Use when someone asks for a sprite sheet, a run, walk, idle or attack cycle, game character animation frames, a texture atlas, or Phaser or Godot sprites from an AI image. Not for chat stickers (gpt-image-sticker-pack), a single looping GIF for the web (gpt-image-gif) or pixel-art sprites (the model fails at pixel art).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill gpt-image-sprite-sheet                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills gpt-image-sprite-sheet --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 16-frame run cycle sprite sheet of my knight ./knight.png for a Phaser game"
- "Turn this character into idle, walk and attack sheets and give me a texture atlas with JSON"
- "Slice ./sheet.png into frames, key out the white background, align the feet and make a looping GIF"
